blocks.text: Real Russian sentences that use what the lesson teaches. Type the missing word, or pick it, until it turns green.

These are real sentences: from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR), with their English translations, and from the public-domain Russian books in this library, with author and title. Each blank is the word the sentence really has; the word in brackets is its dictionary form.

exercises.q: Tom lost half of his chocolate bar, but he gained one friend.
exercises.ru: Том потерял полплитки шоколада, ___ приобрёл друга.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: MRI stands for Magnetic Resonance Imaging, whereas CT stands for Computed Tomography.
exercises.ru: МРТ расшифровывается как "магнитно-резонансная томография", ___ КТ означает "компьютерная томография".
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: That's neither a horse nor a donkey, but a mule.
exercises.ru: Это не лошадь и не осёл, ___ мул.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Surprisingly, the Russian abbreviation "VSEGEI", which sounds like a Russian phrase meaning "all gays", just means "Federal Geological Institute of Russia".
exercises.ru: Удивительно, ___ сокращение "ВСЕГЕИ" означает всего лишь "Всероссийский Геологический Институт".
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Everyone suggests that I stay in bed, but I want to go out and enjoy myself.
exercises.ru: Все советуют мне оставаться в постели, ___ я хочу выйти развеяться.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Tom's computer made a strange noise and then went dead.
exercises.ru: Компьютер Тома издал странный звук, ___ затем отрубился.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: There goes your ride.
exercises.ru: ___ транспорт-то поехал уже.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: War maims people, not only physically but also mentally.
exercises.ru: Война калечит людей не только физически, ___ и душевно.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: She's screaming, not singing.
exercises.ru: Она кричит, ___ не поёт.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: This is a fine car, but the steering wheel has too much play.
exercises.ru: Это хорошая машина, ___ у неё слишком расшатан руль.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: I may be an ascetic, but I appreciate a good meal.
exercises.ru: Я, может, и аскет, ___ хорошо поесть люблю.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Finish the cigarette and then come inside.
exercises.ru: Докури сигарету, ___ затем входи.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: I love candied chestnuts, but they are very sweet.
exercises.ru: Я обожаю глазированные каштаны, ___ они очень сладкие.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: He is rich yet he lives like a beggar.
exercises.ru: Он богат, ___ живет как нищий.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: If you hang clothes up instead of folding them, they won't get as wrinkled.
exercises.ru: Если одежду не сложить, ___ повесить, она будет меньше мяться.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Alpaca wool is softer than sheep wool, but also more expensive.
exercises.ru: Шерсть альпаки мягче овечьей, ___ и дороже.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: But he's so cute!
exercises.ru: ___ он такой хорошенький!
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: This isn't a diamond. It's just plain glass.
exercises.ru: Это не брильянт, ___ простая стекляшка.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: And that's a welcoming sentence, so to speak.
exercises.ru: ___ это, так сказать, приветственное предложение.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: That's not a bumblebee. It's a carpenter bee.
exercises.ru: Это не шмель, ___ пчела-плотник.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
